name: corsair_captain_other_pirates_you_control_and_a_treasure
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature enters, create a Treasure token. Other Pirates you control get +1/+1.' Corsair Captain (a 2/2 Human Pirate) enters: one Treasure. Seat 0's other Pirate is 3/3; the Captain itself stays 2/2 ('other'), seat 0's non-Pirate Bear stays 2/2, and the opponent's Pirate stays 2/2 ('you control').
